title: Common-core evolution residual transfer to local correlations
question: What exact source-authorized common-core residual estimate is sufficient to turn the anchored PAH-OMC-020 finite correlation family into the R-512 minimal-form correlation on compact external Markov-time intervals?
purpose: Provide a stricter alternative certificate for the missing D_n term. The certificate is a conditional Duhamel implication; it does not construct a comparison map, alter PAH-001, or identify a physical time evolution.

fixed_scope.model: Exactly PAH-001 F_rho, original directed PH/LK/AP/TR rates, labelled Gibbs state, OMC-010 regulator path and OMC-004 relational strip.
fixed_scope.finite_limit: The j-to-infinity fixed-n stationary correlation c_n is used only at the registered R-514 scope; the contract addresses the subsequent anchored-n comparison.
fixed_scope.target: T_min(t)=exp(-t K_min), where K_min is the exact R-512 minimal closed nonnegative form. No maximal extension, phasewise direct sum or unnamed target is admitted.
fixed_scope.time: External unaccelerated stochastic Markov time t on a compact interval [0,T]; no quantum, proper or Lorentzian interpretation.
fixed_scope.order: The preregistered j-to-infinity passage at fixed n precedes the anchored n exhaustion. No diagonal or reversed limit is allowed.
fixed_scope.normalization: Original labelled stationary normalization; R-490 C_sw remains a domination input only.

objects.local_core: A single dense cylinder core D_loc contained in the target generator domain, containing the local test vectors and invariant under T_min(s) for 0<=s<=T.
objects.comparison: A source-authorized family U_n on the fixed-n limiting correlation vectors v_n(f), with U_n v_n(f) in the common Hilbert space H and a uniform norm bound N_f on each local f.
objects.finite_evolution: u_n^g(s)=U_n P_n^infty(s)v_n(g), defined by the original PAH-001 finite stationary semigroup after the registered j limit; no new process is defined by this contract.

required_owner_packet.common_space_and_core: One source-authorized H, U_n, D_loc and target K_min domain, with all local f,g represented and U_n v_n(f) uniformly bounded.
required_owner_packet.correlation_identity: For every local f,g and n, c_n(f,g;s)=<U_n v_n(f),u_n^g(s)>_H with the original stationary normalization.
required_owner_packet.initial_recovery: I_n(f)=||U_n v_n(f)-f||_H tends to zero for every local f in the anchored n order.
required_owner_packet.residual_domain: For every local g, u_n^g is absolutely continuous on [0,T], lies in Dom(K_min) almost everywhere, and r_n^g(s)=d/ds u_n^g(s)+K_min u_n^g(s) is Bochner integrable.
required_owner_packet.uniform_residual: R_n(g;T)=integral_0^T ||r_n^g(s)||_H ds tends to zero in the anchored n limit, with the same terminal-square and boundary convention.
required_owner_packet.target_contraction: The R-512 minimal-form semigroup is a contraction on H, and its variation-of-constants identity applies on D_loc.

conditional_theorem.state_vector_bound: If T_min is contractive, then sup_0<=t<=T ||u_n^g(t)-T_min(t)g|| <= I_n(g)+R_n(g;T).
conditional_theorem.correlation_bound: If N_f=sup_n ||U_n v_n(f)|| is finite, then D_n(f,g;T) <= N_f[I_n(g)+R_n(g;T)] + I_n(f)||g||_H.
conditional_theorem.consequence: The displayed initial-recovery and residual limits imply D_n(f,g;T)->0 for every local pair and finite T, supplying the D term in R-534 without a diagonal limit.
conditional_theorem.status: Implication only. None of the six owner fields is supplied by the current hash-pinned source corpus.

diagnostic_fixture.description: A scalar contract oracle evaluates the bound with nonnegative rational defects; it checks the algebra and monotonicity only and is not a PAH process or an estimate.
diagnostic_fixture.role: Exact test oracle; no PAH constant, carrier, rate or infinite-volume assertion.

decision_rule.MAINLINE_ADVANCE: Only when a source-authorized packet instantiates all six owner fields and primary, independent, hostile and Lean checks agree.
decision_rule.NEGATIVE_RESULT: Only an exact PAH-specific contradiction to the residual or initial-recovery requirements qualifies; an absent packet is not a universal no-go.
decision_rule.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: Use while any owner field is absent; retain the explicit bound as a reusable evidence contract.

single_next_question: Can a source-authorized packet provide U_n, a common invariant cylinder core, the original correlation identity, and a vanishing anchored-n residual R_n(g;T) for the exact PAH-001 semigroup?
revisit_condition: Reopen only when all six fields are versioned and hash-pinned or an exact PAH-specific residual contradiction is found; do not repeat finite carriers, physical-empty, BCC or Reading-H calculations.
